evidence_timing.EGFR: frozen after label-independent receptor preparation but before any Stage 13f cognate-redocking result or EGFR benchmark docking score
evidence_timing.FA10: frozen before DUD-E archive download, receptor discovery, ligand allocation, or docking
evidence_timing.HIVPR: frozen before DUD-E archive download, receptor discovery, ligand allocation, or docking

purpose: Test whether the unchanged pair-synergy QUBO receptor-selection workflow transfers from MAPK14 to three prespecified external proteins without target selection based on observed enrichment results.

fixed_target_order.status_at_freeze: Stage 13e input preparation passed; Stage 13f 16-receptor x 3-seed cognate redocking not yet executed
fixed_target_order.reference_policy: retain the already frozen 2RGP common-frame protocol
use the DUD-E reference structure and chain after identity and coordinate audit
use the DUD-E reference biological assembly after dimer and coordinate audit

target_selection_policy.reason: EGFR tests kinase transfer; FA10 and HIVPR provide two mechanistically and structurally distinct non-kinase proteins while retaining enough DUD-E actives for the same panel sizes.
target_selection_policy.technical_infeasibility_policy: Report the target and failed technical gate, continue to the next frozen target, and do not substitute a new target after seeing enrichment results.
target_selection_policy.negative_result_policy: Retain and report every completed target regardless of the direction or significance of the QUBO comparison.

uniform_ligand_panel.disjointness: No internal ligand ID, source row, canonical SMILES, or Bemis-Murcko scaffold may cross train, fresh validation, or locked test.
uniform_ligand_panel.failure_action: Stop the target before preparation if exact disjoint panel sizes cannot be constructed; do not reduce counts after inspecting docking or enrichment.

uniform_receptor_protocol.selection_data: coordinates and metadata only; activity labels and benchmark docking scores prohibited
uniform_receptor_protocol.selection_rule: deterministic max-min structural selection in a target-specific common pocket frame
uniform_receptor_protocol.preparation_rule: exclude incomplete standard amino-acid heavy-atom templates; no silent deletion or modeled repair

frozen_production_protocol.score_aggregation: median across seeds per receptor-ligand pair; selected receptor subsets use min_score

frozen_qubo.retuning_policy: No target-specific weight, target-size, aggregation, penalty, or BEDROC-alpha retuning is permitted.

confirmatory: matched linear Top-3 from the QUBO linear coefficients
literature_supplementary: random forest over all 16 receptor scores
gradient boosting trees over all 16 receptor scores
logistic regression over all 16 receptor scores
all-receptor minimum, mean, and geometric consensus
frozen_comparators.model_selection_boundary: Every fitted model, normalization bound, hyperparameter choice, and receptor subset must be selected inside Train-696 grouped nested cross-validation and frozen before fresh-validation scores are loaded.

validation_endpoints.primary_comparison: exact pair-synergy QUBO Top-3 minus direct BEDROC forward greedy Top-3 on fresh-validation BEDROC alpha=20
validation_endpoints.secondary_comparison: exact pair-synergy QUBO Top-3 minus the strongest literature comparator chosen by Train-696 grouped OOF BEDROC before fresh validation
robustness: positive split-group paired-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound for the primary BEDROC delta
validation_endpoints.locked_test_policy: The locked test remains unavailable until all three target fresh-validation reports and the cross-target decision are finalized.

cross_target_decision.workflow_portability: All technically completed targets must produce finite nondegenerate QUBO coefficients and a valid exact Top-3 solution without target-specific retuning.

qubo_superiority_gate.pooled_analysis: target-stratified paired bootstrap of ligand rankings with a positive 95 percent lower bound

cross_target_decision.quantum_hardware_application_gate: At least two technically completed targets must have nonzero noncardinality quadratic terms and an exact QUBO subset that differs from either matched linear Top-3 or forward-greedy QUBO selection.
cross_target_decision.quantum_advantage_claim: prohibited; hardware execution and fair scaling comparisons are separate future experiments

reporting_policy.EGFR_posthoc_label: EGFR receptor-structure method corrections must remain disclosed; benchmark enrichment remains prospective at this freeze point.

interpretation_boundary: Passing this master protocol can support multi-target portability and, if the frozen statistical gate passes, QUBO superiority over specified classical controls for this benchmark cohort. It cannot establish experimental binding, clinical activity, broad proteome generality, quantum execution, computational quantum advantage, or practical quantum speedup.
